results.name: One explicit composition root publishes the complete deterministic layer order
Feature modules register layers and never replace LW.Engine
The public facade identity is stable and every composed instance is an Engine
Serialized root state contains plain data and no active-actor accessors
Actor-scoped view follows explicit identity without moving authoritative records
Passing an actor view into the facade unwraps the same root without corrupting actors
Explicit partial construction boundaries reproduce historical save stages
Authored factories return the canonical fully composed facade
Save import and deterministic continuation remain exact through the composed static chain
Composed methods remain replaceable for deterministic test and adapter seams
High-level simulation phases are explicit, ordered and presentation-free
Command manifest is explicit, unique and cannot dispatch arbitrary methods
Actor commands dispatch through an explicit identity and preserve direct-command parity
Composition internals remain transient and absent from exported stories
